M.P.A.A. was held from Wimbledon on October 6th and Vaughan Thomas proved an easy winner of the scratch event in 39:02; John Knifton was 2nd in 39:46. Belgrave won the match 120 - 133 and Len Fairman (14 minutes) the handicap from Charlie Speechley (14:30) and Fred Denny (14:30).
John Morris, Fred Denny, Richard Dorman, JOE COLEMAN, John Llewellin,Ed. Crossingham, Tom Carter, Ted Stimpson, Kneeling; Graham Seatter, Ron Day, John Hall.

We regret to inform that two respected Belgravians have recently passed away: Fred Denny and Past President Bill Merryman. We extend our sympathies to their families and will publish an appreciation of each in the next issue of The Belgravian.

Fred Denny was born in 1930 and joined us in 1955. A powerfully built policeman he turned out regularly in Club and Open walks and, of course, for the "boys in blue" in their Championships and matches.
